Is she trying to ruin his relationship with Yidie? Whatever he asks, Jianhe only stares at him coldly, saying nothing. Security eventually throws him out for harassing a patient. Before long, the rift between Weishi and Yidie widens until they break up.
李未时追上了赵倚蝶，向她百般解释，虽然赵很生气，但是看在男朋友的态度诚恳的份上，: Weishi catches up with Yidie and does his best to explain. She is furious, but his sincerity gradually wins her over. He swears he would never treat her that way. Soon afterwards, Jianhe moves to another care home, and Weishi and Yidie's lives return to normal. Then, one night, mysterious men in black stab them both to death. The truth behind it all is buried in the darkness forever.
李未时正玩得电脑起劲，被返回来的赵倚蝶发现，看见这个时候还沉迷游戏的李未时，赵倚: Yidie returns to find Weishi engrossed in a computer game. Seeing him gaming at a time like this, she gives up on him and walks away. He barely glances after her before turning back to the screen. "Engage first! Go, go!" Then his triumphant roar echoes through the care home: "Pentakill! I got a pentakill!" By the time he comes to his senses, Yidie is no longer answering his calls. Unfazed, he dials a familiar number. "Mate, I'm single again. We're going out tonight!"
李未时慌忙中早已失去了理智，对着密码锁乱按一通，以为可以靠运气打开这道门，毕竟他: In his panic, Weishi loses all reason. He mashes the keypad, hoping luck will open the door. After all, being kidnapped is already a stroke of "luck" for an ordinary man. But time is no longer his to control. When he finally comes to his senses, the man in black is standing behind him...
李未时完全忘了自己此行的目的，享受着片刻的安宁时光，没有做出任何能够改变过去的行: Weishi forgets why he came and enjoys a moment of peace, doing nothing to change the past. He thinks he has escaped the men in black. He has no idea their hunt spans time itself: whether he is in 2019 or 2022, they can follow him anywhere. Back in 2022, he dies bewildered, never understanding how any of this began, or why it ended this way...
李未时设法拖住赵倚蝶，可为时已晚，司机慌乱之下也打了方向盘，可于事无补，汽车径直: Weishi tries to hold Yidie back, but it is too late. The driver swerves in panic, to no avail. The car barrels into them. A crash, then deathly silence. Two cold bodies lie in a pool of red. Weishi and Yidie are together now, in another world.
李未时不管三七二十一，打开车门就冲了出去，想要趁黑衣人不注意，偷偷溜走。虽然他已: Without thinking, Weishi opens the car door and rushes out, hoping to slip away while the man in black is distracted. He treads softly, inching along the car, but the man spots him anyway. Without a word, he drives his knife into Weishi...
李未时回到三年前，迷迷糊糊地被人从床上叫醒。看到赵倚蝶就在眼前，然而片刻之后赵倚: Back in the past, Weishi is roused from sleep. Yidie is right before his eyes, but her face slowly turns into Jianhe's. He knows that in the timeline he has chosen, Yidie is lost to him forever. At least she is alive. Remembering their time together three years ago, he gives a rueful smile and gently pats Jianhe's head. The men in black never return, and his life becomes peaceful once more.
李未时还是离林见鹤而去，回到三年后，和赵倚蝶生活在了一起。两人在疗养院见面的时候: Weishi leaves Jianhe after all. Three years later, he is living with Yidie. When they meet at the care home, he sometimes catches sight of a lonely version of himself pushing a wheelchair. What happened to Jianhe weighs on him, but he cannot dwell on it forever. There is room in his heart for only one person: Yidie. He resolves to forget the past and build a life with the woman he loves.
今天，就是赵倚蝶要执行死刑的前夜。李未时见了赵倚蝶最后一面，赵倚蝶早已不是自己认: It is the eve of Yidie's execution. Weishi sees her one last time. The sweet, lovely girl he knew is gone; her face is ashen, her expression haggard and frantic. For a moment, seeing him brings a glimmer of light to her eyes. It soon fades, replaced by anger, disappointment and despair. She turns away, resigned to death. Weishi says nothing. After all these years, his love has only hurt two people. He leaves the prison quietly, alone.
李未时给赵倚蝶交代完所有的事情，他知道自己该走了，至于会去哪里他也说不清楚，三年: Weishi tells Yidie everything. He knows it is time to go, though he cannot say where. With his past self dead, will he still exist when he returns to the future? He is afraid, but this may be the best ending he can give them: his own life in exchange for both women. The thought brings him peace. He closes his eyes and waits for death, for a day everyone will celebrate.
李未时看着徐言搂着赵倚蝶慢慢远去的背影，无奈的摇头笑了笑。回去的路上，遇见一个右: Weishi watches Xu Yan walk away with an arm around Yidie. He shakes his head with a helpless smile. On the way home, he meets a young man with an injured right arm, smoking after handing out leaflets. Weishi remarks on the hard work and poor pay. The man sighs. Four years ago, he almost hit someone while driving, swerved into a tree, wrecked his car and lost an arm. Weishi says life is full of regrets. The man gives a bitter smile. "My own fault for drink-driving. Karma, I suppose. It's not as if there's a time machine to take me back." Weishi freezes, then walks away in silence. In his head, Yidie's words seem to echo: "Honey, that younger schoolmate of yours looks like a stray dog."
